items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Maybe Marge can get them for you or something.

ctx.x: No. And I haven't... I've met one who said that he heard them, and I said, 'Man, I'd give a million dollars for a set of them.' I can't think who it was. And he said... Maybe it was Zutty. He said, 'Maybe I'll try to get them. Maybe Marge can get them for you or something.' And that's the last I heard of them.
